changelog: 📦 Phase 2 Upgrade: Pure Rust Streaming Backup & Archive System (`agy_ide_bridge_rs`): Instant zero-dependency chat, project, and individual `.antigem` conversation backup and restore.
⚡ Replaced Legacy Shell Scripts: `backup_chats`, `restore_chats`, `backup_projects`, and `restore_projects` now execute native Rust engine with zero external `zip` or `python` tool dependencies.
🛡️ High-Throughput Compression: Tested with over 15,000 files and 2.4 GB of workspace data with seamless in-memory and disk streaming.
